items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: I remember him and Pete on trumpet me and Paul in the drum section.

ctx.x: That little bass drum he got.

That little same bass drum Paul Bob Randall showed that. We played the funeral analogy with Peter Bocah and I forgot all the men that had. One man I remember that outfit too. He was a guy who talked to Dave Batalem trumpet player.
